$comment: The quest deck: mini-quests and campaigns. A quest reaches a player through a quest-omen discovery result, or by paying 5 coin at any inn to hear a rumour (draw one). The player reads it and ACCEPTS or DECLINES on the spot; declined cards go to the bottom of the deck for someone else. An accepted quest sits face up by the player's board until completed or abandoned - abandoning is free but the card is discarded from the game, and some campaigns say otherwise. Complexity runs 1 (an errand) to 5 (a campaign that shapes a whole game); the deck is meant to grow at every complexity. Settlement names refer to the Korvane Reach board; a future map brings its own quest cards. Card codes QST-nn.

quests.name: The Miller's Debt
quests.hook: The miller at Grist ground a season's flour on credit, and the credit was grain that never came.

reward.note: And goodwill: your next purchase in Grist is at -10%.

quests.name: Lanterns for Coldwater
quests.hook: The northern nights run eighteen hours in winter, and Coldwater's last lantern went through the harbour ice with the boat it was rigged to.
quests.task: Deliver a lantern (the item) to Coldwater.

reward.note: And a bed by the stove: resting at Coldwater is free for you, all game.

quests.name: The Boar of Bramblehold
quests.hook: Something is rooting up the Bramblehold coppices by night, and the woodcutters have opinions about its size.
quests.task: Travel to any Bramblehold Wood hex and resolve a Stone Boar encounter there - slay it, or better, keep it.

reward.note: If domesticated: keep the boar, and score 1 victory point. If slain: gain 4 meat, 2 hide and its earth mana.

quests.name: Word to Dry Wells
quests.hook: A sealed letter, a worried clerk, and a settlement three days into the sand. Nobody says what is in the letter. The seal is the Seat's.
quests.task: Carry the letter from Vossgard to Dry Wells within 4 rounds of accepting.

reward.note: And the well-keeper's gratitude: one free automatic survey success on any desert hex, once.

quests.name: The Strangler in the Mire
quests.hook: Umber Hollow has stopped counting its missing in ones. The fen path is closed, the peat is cut short, and the inn is full of people who will not walk home.
quests.task: Slay the Mire Strangler within 2 hexes of Umber Hollow. If no Strangler is on the board, travelling those marsh hexes finds it on any discovery monster result, automatically.

reward.note: And Umber Hollow's freedom of the house: its inn is free to you, all game.

quests.name: A Draught for Fen's End
quests.hook: The sisters who keep the Fen's End sickhouse sent a list: one draught, properly brewed, before the ague season. The list is dated. The date is close.
quests.task: Deliver a Healing Draught or Physic Tonic to Fen's End within 5 rounds of accepting. Brewing it yourself or buying it both count.

reward.note: And word spreads of it: score 1 victory point.

quests.name: The Ironspine Road
quests.hook: There is one pass over the Ironspine worth a rail bed, and three interests that would rather there were none. The Seat wants a road first, to prove the line can live.

stages.name: Survey the Pass
stages.task: End a leg on 2 different mountain hexes between Vossgard and Port Malchior and succeed at a survey on each.

reward.note: The Seat's cartographers share their notes: Plan Route costs you no effort, all game.

stages.name: Prove the Road
stages.task: Escort a caravan (yours or a hired one) from Vossgard to Port Malchior without losing any cargo to any event, bandit or monster.

stages.name: The Thing in the Tunnel
stages.task: The old bore under the pass is not empty. Enter with light and resolve a Forge Wight encounter - slay it, befriend it, or enslave it.

reward.note: And the pass is yours by use and custom: rail you lay on mountain hexes costs half build-points, all game.

quests.notes: Stages in order. Abandoning this campaign discards it for every player - the pass stays shut.

quests.name: The Drowned Bell of Taleowick
quests.hook: Taleowick's chapel bell went into the bay a lifetime ago, boat and bellringer with it, and on flat calm nights the village swears it still rings the hour. Lately it has been ringing the wrong one.

stages.name: The Tale at the Inn
stages.task: Rest a round at Taleowick and pay 10 coin for the whole story.

reward.note: The sexton's map of the old channel: your ships and barges treat the four Splinter Isles hexes as home water - no discovery rolls there.

stages.name: The Sounding
stages.task: End a ship or barge leg on 3 different shallow-water hexes within 2 hexes of Taleowick. Each triggers its discovery roll as normal; survive whatever answers.

reward.note: The bell-clapper, hauled up in a net: counts as 1 gold, but keep it - it is the campaign's key.

stages.name: What Rings It
stages.task: The Deepwater Maw has been using the bell as a lure. It rises against the ship carrying the clapper: fight and slay it. Strength 5, health 12, and it strikes first unless a character aboard has water mana stored.

reward.note: The phylactery is found inside the bell, which the village lets you keep the story of.

quests.notes: Stages in order. If the Maw is slain by anyone else first, stage 3 completes at the Maw's hex with the clapper aboard - the bell falls silent either way.
